cameraHost.description: Hostname / IP address of the Pi-camera bridge server.

cameraPort.description: TCP port the bridge is listening on.

picam.description: Dictionary of camera property name → value pairs applied via ``setPropertyValue`` at startup.

useMockOnFailure.description: Optional, default ``true``: when the camera cannot be opened, a mock camera stands in until **Reconnect** in Hardware status replaces it with the real one (a detector needs its sensor size at construction, so an absent camera cannot be left without a backend). ``false`` makes a missing camera a startup error.
